card.name: Digits inside numbers and ranges
card.fires_on: Punctuation or digits in the middle of a number, often after 'to' in a range or after a decimal point, such as the '.' in 0.5 or the first digit of a second value. Seen in measurements, ages and percentages.

modes.label: Decimal point or slash in range
modes.description: The '.' or '/' right after a leading digit in a range or measurement.

modes.label: Leading digit of second number
modes.description: The first digit of a number that follows 'to', 'and' or 'were' in an age, percent or measurement.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are unrelated name pieces and foreign characters, so there is no clear output effect beyond more number text.
card.plain: It fires while a number is partway written, such as a decimal or the start of a second value in a range.
